# Columns:  id  kind  file  code-site  statement
#   kind = FILE       a machine-checked obligation file; terminating/run.sh runs it and
#          SCHEMATIC  a FILE whose theorem is an induction SCHEMA over the Space grammar or over the
#                     component arity: the file pins the base, the step, and the instances the
#                     compiler actually emits, and the general arity/depth follows by that step.
#          PROPERTY   a syntactic or executable property, discharged by a Scala test rather than by
#                     a prover, because an SMT model of it would be a re-implementation.
#          CITED      already discharged by an obligation OUTSIDE terminating/; the row exists so
#                     the code site is not left looking uncovered.
#          NEGATIVE-RESULT  a kept, annotated FAILED attempt.  Not run by run.sh.
#          OPEN       stated here, NOT discharged.  The reason is in the named file's header.
#          MECHANIZED (proofs/lean/…)  discharged by a Lean-checked theorem; the `file` column names the theorem(s)
#                     and `scripts/check_lean.sh` audits their axioms.  Qualified `PARAMETRIC` when a premise is
#                     left explicit (its own row says which), `PER RUN` when an executable invariant must hold
#                     on the run for the theorem to apply (`SCReport.leanCovered`).
#          ADMITTED   an explicit trusted assumption (docs/TRUSTED.md); none remain after 2E.3.
#          OPEN+DIFFERENTIAL / OPEN+NARROWED / REFUTED-CLOSED / CONSTRUCTION+GATE  variants of OPEN and CITED,
# "TOTAL over the recursion-lowering surface" means: every function that creates, consumes, or
# rewrites a Space.Fixpoint or a recursive Space.Call has at least one row.  The eleven such sites
# Supercompiler.scala {309/473/728 fold/msg/drive}.  Line numbers are as of this change set.
# A row whose kind is OPEN or PROPERTY is NOT a proved obligation.  Read STATUS.tsv for what a
# prover actually said; read the file header for what was attempted and what compensating coverage
# exists.  Never turn an OPEN row into a FILE row by weakening its statement.

The four-valued variance analysis is SOUND: a `+` label denotes a monotone dependence on the mention, `-` an antitone one, `·` a constant one (`Rel`), for every constructor of the language, with the routine table trusted through `VarGood` (each routine grows with its arguments as its row says).  `Var.compose`/`Var.join` are the composition table; `Variance.of` is the Scala twin arm for arm.

A positive SCC as a SIMULTANEOUS system `X_i = init_i ∪ F_i(X̄; L)` has a least post-fixpoint, the union of the Kleene chain of its tagged-union form (O4's encoding), componentwise least; the one-equation system's solution IS `Space.fixpoint`'s denotation (unary correspondence); a stratum needs monotonicity in its OWN variables only — a `-`/`0` dependency on a completed lower stratum is a frozen constant, which is why `Scc.certified` admits it and rejects it inside an SCC.

THE DIFFERENTIAL TRANSFER: for `old ≤ new` on the changing variables and a body positive in each, `⟦s⟧new ⊆ ⟦s⟧old ∪ dden s` and `dden s ⊆ ⟦s⟧new` (D1/D2, per rule — nonlinear bodies enumerate every term with a changed argument, new iteration heads take the whole body, nested fixpoints and frozen callees take the whole new value); hence the STEP EQUATION `A ∪ deltaStep(F, A, lastΔ) = A ∪ F(A)` under the invariant `F(A_prev) ⊆ A`, and the semi-naive and naive recurrences agree at EVERY round (`Exec.run(verify = true)` re-checks it per round; DeltaIRCheck asserts it).
